name: Fang of Vagash
summary: In Dun Morogh, Vagash stalks the rams above Amberstill Ranch. His fang proves the deadly predator has been slain.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: Above Amberstill Ranch, Vagash hunts the rams under cover of darkness. The high crags shelter fierce predators, but none has troubled the local ranches as much as he has. Ironforge’s troops are stretched thin, so the herdsmen go without the city guard’s protection. His severed fang gives the breeders proof that Vagash is dead and their pasturelands are safe again.

faq.q: What is the Fang of Vagash used for?
aliases: what to do with fang of vagash
faq.answer: The breeders at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh take Vagash’s fang as proof that he has been slain. They reward the hunter who protected their livelihood.
Vagash is a deadly beast that dens in the snowy hills above Dun Morogh’s ram pastures. He raids the herds at night, and local dwarves fear him.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Ironforge guard killed Vagash?
faq.answer: Ironforge’s troops are spread thin, with few soldiers to spare for rural patrols. The ranchers must rely on passing adventurers to deal with dangerous predators.

angles.text: Amberstill Ranch raises hardy mountain rams for dwarven mountaineers and travelers. Bringing back Vagash’s fang helps preserve Ironforge’s prized breed of mount.
Tracking Vagash through Dun Morogh’s freezing crags tests a hunter’s skills at tracking, wilderness survival, and slaying beasts.
